aesthetics: Zara Studio + Massimo Dutti + The Row mix. White-dominant, lots of whitespace, ultra premium, high conversion-focused. Editorial, minimal, sophisticated.

rules: Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for large headings (text-4xl+).
Avoid bold weights for large text; prefer font-light or font-normal for a high-end editorial feel.
Use uppercase tracking-widest (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines, small labels, and menu items.
Never center text by default. Use left-alignment for body and product details. Center-align only for hero statements and lookbook titles.
No full-screen gradients. Keep backgrounds solid pure white (#FFFFFF) to act as a gallery wall.
Use #FAFAFA subtly to separate sections like cart summaries or checkout panels.
Text should be deep black (#111111), never muddy grays for important info.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24. Whitespace is critical to convey luxury.
layout.grid: Use asymmetrical layouts for editorial sections (bento grid mode A). For products, use strict 4-column grids with tight gaps.
layout.corners: rounded-none (sharp edges strictly enforced for a luxury, tailored feel).

header.style: Sticky at top, crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Bottom border 1px solid #E4E4E7. Logo centered. Menu links center/left. Icons (Search, Favorites, Account, Cart) on the right.

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#111111] text-white hover:bg-[#333333] transition-colors. Secondary: border border-[#111111] bg-transparent text-[#111111] hover:bg-[#111111] hover:text-white. Padding py-4 px-8 uppercase text-sm tracking-widest.

product_cards.style: Cardless. Image aspect-ratio [3/4] or [4/5]. Hover effect reveals secondary image. Product name, price, and color swatches placed below the image (left-aligned). No bounding boxes or borders around products.

inputs_and_forms.style: Minimalist 'Underline' style: border-b border-[#E4E4E7] bg-transparent py-3 px-0, no rounded corners. Focus: border-[#111111] ring-0. Used in checkout and PANAMA Club newsletter.

campaign_banner.style: Full width, very thin height, bg-[#111111] text-[#FFFFFF], centered text text-xs uppercase tracking-widest.

hero.description: Hero Banner - Two women lying down editorial style. Text overlay: 'Timeless Elegance, Modern Confidence' with 'Premium kadın giyim koleksiyonu' subtitle.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Images scale up slightly (scale-105 duration-700 ease-out) inside an overflow-hidden container. On product cards, primary image fades out to reveal secondary image seamlessly.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Background colors swap smoothly. Cart add causes a micro-interaction on the cart icon (e.g., small bounce or counter update).
motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Implement smooth scroll mechanics. Lookbook sections should use parallax scrolling.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='checkout-submit-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio. No text should be completely unreadable over images (use gradient overlays like bg-gradient-to-t from-black/40 to-transparent if text is placed on images).

pages_to_build: Homepage (Hero, Categories, Best Sellers, Campaign, Lookbook, Reviews, Instagram Grid, Newsletter PANAMA Club)
Product Detail Page (Large photo gallery with zoom, name, price, description, size/color, Buy Now, Add to Cart)
Multi-step Checkout Page (Delivery info, shipping method, payment: Credit Card/Apple Pay/Google Pay/Bank Transfer, persistent order summary)
instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT USE INTER, ROBOTO, OR OPEN SANS FOR HEADINGS. Use Cormorant Garamond exclusively for headers.
Strictly follow the white-dominant aesthetic. Do not add colored backgrounds to sections. Rely on whitespace.
Component styling: Keep everything sharp (rounded-none). Remove shadows from cards; rely on borders or spacing instead.
Hero Banner: Must have the exact phrase 'Timeless Elegance, Modern Confidence' and 'Premium kadın giyim koleksiyonu'.
Product Cards: Always show a second image on hover. Do not wrap them in traditional white 'Cards' with borders and shadow. They should feel 'cardless'.
Icons: Use Phosphor icons with light/thin weight to maintain premium aesthetic.
Testing: Add data-testid to every single button, link, and input.
